nodes.label: RoomSendEventRestServlet
nodes.desc: Handles PUT /rooms/{roomId}/send/{eventType}/{txnId} (class at L416) and hands the JSON body to EventCreationHandler.create_and_send_nonmember_event (L493).

nodes.label: HttpTransactionCache
nodes.desc: Idempotency layer: a retried PUT with the same txn_id returns the first result instead of duplicating the message (L50).

nodes.label: EventCreationHandler
nodes.desc: Builds, auth-checks and persists client events; a Linearizer named room_event_creation_limit caps concurrent sends per room at 1 to avoid forking the event DAG (L488, L518).

nodes.label: EventsPersistenceStorageController
nodes.desc: Batches events per room via a persist queue (L200) and recomputes forward extremities plus the current-state delta before writing (L342, L405).

nodes.label: PersistEventsStore
nodes.desc: Single SQL transaction writes event JSON, state groups and stream ordering (_persist_events_txn, L1084).

nodes.label: Notifier
nodes.desc: on_new_room_events (L357) wakes long-polling /sync requests on this process and pokes replication so other workers learn about the new stream token (L441).

nodes.label: SyncHandler
nodes.desc: wait_for_sync_for_user (L633) parks the client request until the notifier signals fresh events, then assembles the timeline.

nodes.label: EventsStream
nodes.desc: Replication stream NAME='events' (L148-151): the row feed that carries persisted events out to worker processes.

nodes.label: FederationStream
nodes.desc: Replication stream NAME='federation' (L38): queued rows that drive a dedicated federation-sender worker.

nodes.label: FederationSender
nodes.desc: Wakes on notify_new_events (L529), walks new events in _process_event_queue_loop (L549) and routes each PDU/EDU to its per-destination queue; _send_pdu at L821.

nodes.label: FederationSendServlet / FederationServer
nodes.desc: Receives PUT /_matrix/federation/v1/send/{txn_id}; FederationSendServlet.on_PUT (L88) reaches FederationServer.on_incoming_transaction (L317) which splits PDUs and EDUs.

nodes.label: TypingWriterHandler / PresenceHandler
nodes.desc: Typing updates become m.typing EDUs via build_and_send_edu (L189); presence fans out with send_presence_to_destinations (presence.py L450).
